xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex19112024-09-1013-25-17" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="Closing verses"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4616">dpal ldan dus 'khor <lb n="15b3"/> bde stong gnyis med kyi || bsgrub thabs mdor bsdus rnal 'byor bcu gnyis pa</rs> || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6830">shakya'i dge slong chos grub dpal</rs> dang ni | grogs <lb n="15b4"/> mchog dga' yis <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4608">bdag</rs> la legs bskul phyir || snyigs ma'i dus na <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">rgyal ba gnyis pa</rs>'i tshul || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3905">kun spangs chos rje</rs>'i gsung bzhin <lb n="15b5"/> rang bzo'i || dri ma med pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4608">shes rab</rs> ming can gyis || legs par bris la nyes nongs bzod par gsol ||</seg></TEI>
source: 1_019_11_Shes rab 'bum_dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bcu gnyis pa.xml
